title: Yale's secret club makes you confess your sex life in a coffin ⚰️
caption:
Skull and Bones is real. Three presidents were in it. ⚰️
Tag the friend who'd confess everything 😏
first_comment: Tag the friend who'd spill everything in the coffin 👇
sources: Robbins A. (2002) 'Secrets of the Tomb: Skull and Bones, the Ivy League, and the Hidden Paths of Power' (Little, Brown) (15 members a year, the Tomb, coffin confession 'Connubial Bliss', leaving the room when the name is said)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Skull and Bones' (founded 1832; members William Howard Taft, George H. W. Bush, George W. Bush)
CBS News 60 Minutes (2004) 'Skull and Bones' (Bush and Kerry both members)
Reuters / The New York Times (2009) 'Geronimo's Heirs Sue Secret Yale Society Over His Skull'
